title: Hinomori Shizuku — Secret Negotiation〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you next time, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did great today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You especially, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you were on a roll during our talk segment!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. You also segued us between segments so smoothly and made so many funny comments.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm the talker for the group, right?
It's my job to make everything sound interesting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. She's finally back to being her old self.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She really had me worried for a moment there...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and I had another look at the messages the students from that school sent us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we came across one student who seemed very interested in when you were on all those variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You felt concerned after reading this, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were wondering if that message dredged up some unpleasant memories...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I knew this entire time that Airi was still bothered by what she experienced when she was on all those variety shows...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And my actions show that I didn't do enough to take her feelings into consideration.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I even brought up Happy Everyday with her during numerous conversations...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It must've been so hard for her to hear that name coming out of my mouth.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She seems much better now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey...
Earth to Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Y-Yes, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: About us doing an after-party...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An after-party? Oh, to celebrate how the graduation event went...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It would've been nice to do this sooner, but I thought we should celebrate since this was the first offer we received as MMJ.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How about it, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Great, then we're all set!
Hehe. I can't wait!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Welcome, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting me over.
Sorry if it feels like I'm here all the time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's always my pleasure to have you over.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, I should tell Airi before Haruka and Minori get here...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still haven't thanked you for what you did, have I, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thanking me? For what?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For getting permission to use that song during the event. I heard that it caused you a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not even in my wildest dreams did I ever think that I'd get a chance to sing that song. I can't thank you enough, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I also want to thank the person you talked to about this. Can you get me in touch with them?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
They mentioned that they'd like to talk to you as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great! Ideally, I'd like to thank them in person. You think that's possible?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you can leave that to me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But there's something I'd like to discuss with you as well, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I... I'm so sorry...
About Happy Everyday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew what you went through while you were on those variety shows still bothered you, but I still kept bringing it up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Looking back, I feel awful about what I said and did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is that what this is about?
Don't worry, you big dope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You watched my shows every time they aired and you really enjoyed them, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, absolutely!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See? So quit being such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, I started feeling a little embarrassed each time after I found out that you were watching on the other end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Haruka and Minori should be here soon, so why don't we start setting up for our party?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind if I borrow your kitchen, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're more than welcome to, and I'd like to help as well!
